description: Elixir repos: toolchain in .tool-versions or mise.toml, Hex deps, Phoenix asset binaries. Each repo sets `constraints.erlang` itself, next to the pin it has to match.
No dockerfile or docker-compose manager: a repo's elixir-image workflow (ftes/ci) keeps the Dockerfile on the toolchain, and no repo runs anything from docker-compose in CI or production.

packageRules.description: Preserve Elixir's OTP build compatibility suffix
An Erlang major needs two edits Renovate can't make: Elixir's -otp-N suffix (the versioning keeps it) and the repo's constraints.erlang
prBodyNotes: **Before merging:** raise Elixir's `-otp-N` suffix to this Erlang major in the same file, and `constraints.erlang` in renovate.json, which Renovate builds mix.lock with.

customManagers.description: esbuild binary version installed by the esbuild hex package (downloaded from npm)
